examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Single-mode accordion with one item open via `default-value`.

examples.name: IconPosition
examples.summary: `trailing` and `leading` chevron placement side by side.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.summary: The middle item carries the per-item `disabled` prop and cannot toggle.

examples.name: WithLogViewer
examples.summary: Real composition: the `Accordion.Content` slot takes any component. Here each deploy item wraps a full `LogViewer` (header and content) over a deploy log.

examples.name: Multiple
examples.summary: `type="multiple"` with two items open at once via an array `default-value`.

examples.name: Page JSON
examples.summary: The same content in the marketing site's page JSON: `Accordion` is a scene, so a band places it by name in its `scene` slot (here `console-showcase-section` with `variant: "diagram"` and `texture: "none"`, so nothing is painted behind it) and `SitePage` renders the entry with no code. Its items are the scene's `children`: each `AccordionItem` holds an `AccordionTrigger` and an `AccordionContent`, and their text is a text child.
